description: A fungal infection causing brown, irregular lesions on leaves that spread outward from the leaf tip, common in humid conditions after rainfall.
remedy: Spray a copper-based fungicide (e.g. copper oxychloride 0.3%) in the early morning or evening. Remove and destroy severely affected leaves to slow spread. Repeat after 10 days if symptoms persist.
prevention_tips: Avoid overhead irrigation; water at the base of the plant instead.
Ensure proper spacing between plants for airflow.
Rotate crops each season to break the disease cycle.
Remove crop residue after harvest instead of leaving it in the field.
